heading: Assignment of personnel as instructors
lead: The Commandant may assign any member to appropriate instruction duty at the Academy.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on title 14, U.S.C., 1946 ed., § 15i (Apr. 16, 1937, ch. 107, § 8, 50 Stat. 67). Changes were made in phraseology. 81st Congress, House Report No. 557.

Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 192 of this title as this section. 1984—Pub. L. 98–557 substituted reference to member for reference to commissioned officer, warrant officer, and enlisted man.
